feeds.title: ExChristian.Net
feeds.description: The ExChristian.Net blog and forum exist for the express purpose of encouraging those who have decided to leave religion behind. The contents of these pages are not intended as an open challenge for Christians to avenge what they perceive as an offense against their religious beliefs.

feeds.title: Debunking Christianity
feeds.description: John W. Loftus is a Philosopher and Counter-Apologist who earned MA, MDiv, and ThM degrees, the last of which was under William Lane Craig. John also studied in a Ph.D. program at Marquette University. Debunking Christianity covers topics such as Bible, Christianity, Faith, Evangelical Christian, Atheism, Atheist, Creation, and more.

feeds.title: Ex-Apologist
feeds.description: I am a Professor of Philosophy at El Camino College in Torrance, CA. I work on issues in epistemology (esp. the epistemology of modality), metaphysics, and philosophy of religion. In my spare time, I enjoy spending time with my family and surfing at nearby Redondo Beach.

feeds.title: Bohemian Humanist » Ex-Christianity
feeds.description: The following section of Bohemian Humanist is dedicated to articles and write-ups on Ex-Christianity. Welcome to my site, Bohemian Humanist. My name is Abby and I am a passionate writer, poet, musician, and generally creative creature. I set up this website in October 2016, after discovering my love of blogging when writing about my travels. I hope the content of my site makes you think and makes you laugh.
